Didn’t see any reviews or videos on YouTube about this dryer . I decided to purchase it anyways because I bought the same brand washer. So let me tell you this small dryer does the job. This is a great dryer if you have only one or two people, and have limited space to set up a washer and dryer. I bought this to complement the Black and Decker mini-washing machine I had recently purchased. This is a very easy machine to set up, Requires little space or technical expertise to set it up and, once it's running, it dries clothes as fast as a full-sized dryer, just not as many at once. It is really quiet, and the filter is easy to clean after every load.  For me, a one person household, it works great, and saves me a ton of money and time versus going to the laundromat. I didn't have the space to set up a full-sized set, so I opted for the compact washer and dryer, and it has turned out to be just the ticket to suit my needs. Now, it is so much more convenient, because I don't have to take the time out of my schedule to load everything up and head to the laundromat and to have to sit there for almost an hour, between washing and drying, This will dry a full load of clothes in about 30 to 35 minutes. As I said, it's great for one person, or maybe two, as it only handles a smaller load, but the functionality and convenience more than offset the limited capacity, and it will pay for itself, in time and hard money savings, in less than a year. It is very quiet, for a smaller machine, I thought it would be somewhat noisier, but it's actually more quiet than the full-sized dryer I used to have. [[VIDEOID:7eb5c6736a0d962495c9ef7de5c14c4a]] We bought this little dryer as a stop gap while we figured out whether our 10-year-old Maytag dryer could be repaired. This Black & Decker dryer is small, but mighty, and shipped quickly from Amazon.

Please know that this dryer doesn’t have as much power as a full-size dryer, so drying time is a bit longer, but it also doesn’t have as much of an electrical requirement. It uses a grounded three-prong plug and the instructions say it should be on a dedicated circuit. This means one shouldn’t plug it into an outlet on a crowded circuit and run the dryer and another appliance with a high current draw. We opted to use this unit in our garage on the same circuit as a new upright freezer and experienced no problems.

I bought this and the companion Black & Decker protable washer for a cabin that doesn't have a dedicated laundry room or laundry hook ups. I also bought a small cart that the dryer fits on. I roll the dryer into a closet when not in use. The washer comes with wheels so it gets stored away also.

The dryer plugs into a standard 110V outlet. Because its running on normal power it does take longer to dry things than a large electric dryer using 220V. Don't let that discourage you. I have dried three (3) full size, plush bath towels at the same time. They took about an hour and twenty minutes to completely dry. T-shirts and socks, maybe 50 minutes. Like a full size dryer - it all depends on how much you put in and what type of fabric. THE MOST IMPORTANT THING IS TO CLEAN THE LINT SCREEN AFTER EVERY USE. Keep that clean and you will be happy with results - dont clean it and drying times will double or triple. So clean your screen.

I run the dryer exhaust out a window usually. However, I have let the exhaust run into the cabin also. I do not use dryer sheets. The manufacturer instructions discourage this. I have done some reading and there are claims that the dryer sheets emit harmful chemicals during a drying cycle. Better safe than sorry is my thought. So, I've been using the little granules that go in the washing. They provide a mild scent similar to a dryer sheet. So those dirty t-shirts and shorts end up smelling fresh without the harmful dryer sheets.<

Purchased this March 7th 2022 and I’ve used it almost daily since. Here’s my pros/cons list:
Pro’s
-Small enough for small spaces
-Extremely light weight
-Does a great job at drying my clothes hot enough to kill germs but not so hot it melts designs on kids shirts or ends of drawstrings internal temps DO reach over 140* which is what I wanted. Kids in school can bring home everything and this dryer will kill it.
-Does amazing at not releasing lint into my house everywhere.
-Does not heat my house too much or make things too humid. It’s a small apartment with no ac so I’d notice these things if it did.
-It DOES have a lint trap!!!!! It’s the large circular disk on the inside back of the dryer. Pull gently to remove and gently disassemble to remove lint. Don’t forget to put the felt back and NOT between the disks.
-It plugs into a 120v outlet (normal outlet in the US)!! Woohoo!!! Has never tripped a breaker in the 6 months of use.
Cons
-No where in the manual does it mention a lint trap. HOWEVER, there’s a small sticker above the door once opened that reads “Warning: Clean the lint trap regularly”. It took me a while to figure out what and where this lint trap was.
-It’s drying time is over 3 hours (200 minutes to be exact) if
